transcript.text: Thanks for calling Summit Air, this is the virtual assistant. How can I help?
my carbon monoxide alarm just went off i'm outside now
If a window is right there, open it. Then get everyone out of the house now and call 911 once you're outside.
okay i'm already outside i think i'm fine the headache's going away i guess can you just send someone now

Okay, stay outside. Please call 911 or the gas company from there now, even if you feel better. A technician can come after the problem has been shut off.

Do you want me to book that visit for after it's shut off?
okay i'll call them right after this yeah sure book the visit for after it's 23 15 31st street astoria one one one oh two
Let me check the ZIP first. The address is in our area. Is that 23-15 31st Street in Astoria, and is it a house or an apartment?
yes 23 15 31st street astoria one one one oh two it's a house i think can you hurry up with the booking
I need to know what's wrong so the technician comes prepared. What's the problem, and since when?
the hallway carbon monoxide alarm went off about ten minutes ago right by the furnace i'm outside now by myself
Please get outside and call 911 from there.
yeah i'm outside i'll call them right after this i promise

Good. Please call 911 right now, before anything else.

Once the gas is shut off, we'll get a technician to you. Stay outside until someone tells you it's safe to go back in.
okay right after this i'll call them what's the earliest time you can send someone

Let me look at the earliest time for you. I've marked this as one of our most urgent calls, so you get our soonest opening. Today there's 12 to 4 this afternoon. Does that work, once the gas is shut off?
yeah 12 to 4 works take the earliest one can you read back the address so i know you have it right
Let me read that back: your home at 23-15 31st Street, Astoria, 11102, and the best number is 631, 555, 0165. Is that right?
yes that's right thanks i've got to go call nine one one now bye
Good, go call 911 now and stay outside. Thanks for calling Summit Air. I still need a name for the booking. What's your name?
sofia marchetti okay i'm hanging up now to call them bye

You're booked for today, with the technician arriving between 12 and 4. The technician can only work on it once the gas company or 911 has shut it off and said it's safe, so stay outside until then. Please call 911 now. For your safety, I'd recommend hanging up now, getting outside, and calling 911 from there. We'll follow up once you're safe.
